request: Build a small Jac web app for class attendance. A teacher creates classes, adds students to a class, and marks each student present or absent for a date. The page shows each student's attendance percentage for their class. Marking the same student twice for one date replaces the earlier mark. Keep the attendance rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: Students can be added to a class and marked present or absent for a date.
Attendance percentage is present days divided by marked days, shown per student.
A second mark for the same student and date replaces the first.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
